transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to review the reinstatement application for the student returning from medical leave. As you know, the draft plan currently lists 12 credits for the fall term, places STAT-210 in a regular daytime section, and doesn't include any disability-accommodation or financial-aid conditions. Before I sign off on this plan, I want to make sure we've completed the cross-office review and that all relevant conditions have been properly considered. What can each of you share with me today?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical discrepancy. In my advising meeting with the student this week, I confirmed that their continuing employment schedule permits a maximum of exactly 9 credits in the fall term. I recorded this in my advising notes, but the reinstatement draft still shows 12 credits. This needs to be corrected before the plan is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag another critical discrepancy. In the registrar's course inventory, I confirmed that the student's required STAT-210 section is offered only online in the summer term — not as a regular daytime section in the fall. The draft plan currently places STAT-210 in a regular daytime fall section, which is incorrect. The plan must move STAT-210 out of the fall daytime schedule and identify the online summer section instead. I should note that this inventory update has not yet reached the reinstatement file, which is likely why the draft still reflects the incorrect placement.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical omission in the reinstatement draft. My completed disability-services review confirms that this student has an active accommodation requiring 1.5-times testing time and a reduced-distraction testing setting. This accommodation record has not yet been attached to the reinstatement draft. The finalized written plan must include this accommodation condition so the student receives a complete and accurate plan showing all conditions attached to their reinstatement.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical omission from the financial-aid side. I've confirmed that reinstated financial-aid eligibility requires the student to sign an academic-progress contract by exactly August 15. However, our financial-aid system has not yet added that condition to the draft plan. This deadline-specific condition must be incorporated into the finalized written plan so the student has a complete and accurate picture of all conditions attached to their reinstatement.
transcript.speaker: A5
